name: nanogpt-provider-vscode-extension
description: Bring NanoGPT models to VS Code and Copilot Chat as a language model provider.

routingMode.description: NanoGPT routing surface for chat completions.

provider.description: Optional upstream provider id sent as X-Provider when routingMode is paygo.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional reasoning effort sent to reasoning-capable models.

reasoningOutput.description: Controls how streamed reasoning is surfaced. Native uses VS Code's thinking part when available; visible falls back to normal text.

toolCallingStrategy.description: Controls tool-calling reliability mode. Native forwards NanoGPT tools directly, auto retries empty or likely scaffolding-only native tool turns with a stricter bridge prompt, and bridge always uses the stricter bridge prompt.

walkthroughs.title: NanoGPT for VS Code
walkthroughs.description: Set up the NanoGPT language model provider and bring NanoGPT models into the Copilot Chat picker.

steps.title: Save your NanoGPT API key
steps.description:
Store the key in VS Code's secret storage so it never gets synced or committed with your workspace settings.
[Open Manage API Key](command:nanogpt.manage)

steps.title: Pick NanoGPT models in Copilot Chat
steps.description:
Open the Copilot Chat model picker to add NanoGPT to the list of available vendors. If no models appear yet, the picker falls back to a small default catalogue so you can send a test message while discovery runs.
[Open Model Picker](command:workbench.action.chat.manageModels)

steps.title: Tune NanoGPT per-model settings
steps.description: Each NanoGPT model exposes a per-model configuration panel with routing surface, reasoning effort, reasoning output, and tool-calling strategy. Click the gear icon next to a NanoGPT model in the picker to edit these fields.

steps.title: Verify a chat round-trip
steps.description:
Send a short message through Copilot Chat with a NanoGPT model and watch the Output panel for a structured log line. Enable verbose logging in workspace settings if you need debug-level detail.
[Run Refresh Models](command:nanogpt.refreshModels)

steps.title: Reset NanoGPT (if you get stuck)
steps.description:
Wipe the saved API key, all `nanogpt.*` settings at every scope, and the cached model list. After the reset completes, VS Code offers a follow-up menu to re-enter the API key or jump to the model picker.
[Run Reset](command:nanogpt.resetConfiguration)

nanogpt.apiKey.markdownDescription: DEPRECATED — Prefer the `NanoGPT: Manage API Key` command because settings can be synced or committed by accident. This setting is no longer consulted by default; it is only honored when the extension is explicitly opted into insecure credential resolution.

nanogpt.routingMode.description: NanoGPT routing surface for chat completions.

nanogpt.provider.description: Optional upstream provider id sent as X-Provider when routingMode is paygo.

nanogpt.models.description: Optional allowlist of NanoGPT model ids. Leave empty to discover models from NanoGPT.

nanogpt.reasoningEffort.description: Optional reasoning effort sent to reasoning-capable models.

nanogpt.reasoningOutput.description: Controls how streamed reasoning is surfaced. Native uses VS Code's thinking part when available; visible falls back to normal text.

nanogpt.toolCallingStrategy.description: Controls tool-calling reliability mode. Native forwards NanoGPT tools directly, auto retries empty or likely scaffolding-only native tool turns with a stricter bridge prompt, and bridge always uses the stricter bridge prompt.

nanogpt.verboseLogging.description: Enable verbose NanoGPT diagnostics in the Output panel. When enabled, debug and trace logs include sanitized request configuration and HTTP lifecycle details without logging prompts, tool inputs, or secrets.
